subtitle: A fictional example for building on-brand campaign and social assets
sourceNote: Fictional example derived from example.com — replace every value with evidence from the supplied website.
overview: Northstar Studio uses a high-contrast editorial system with deep navy foundations, electric blue calls to action, and warm coral highlights.
The system balances precise data-oriented structure with soft atmospheric imagery and generous space for concise messaging.

palettes.title: Core Palette
palettes.intro: Use navy and warm white for most surfaces; reserve electric blue and coral for emphasis.

typography.name: Inter
typography.description: Primary interface and body family with a neutral, precise tone.

typography.name: DM Serif Display
typography.description: Selective display face for campaign headlines and editorial moments.

typeScale: Display — DM Serif Display, 64–88 px desktop, compact line height
Label — Inter SemiBold, 12–14 px, slight positive tracking
logoNotes: Use the full horizontal lockup on light surfaces and the reversed lockup on navy.
Keep clear space equal to the cap height of the wordmark; do not place it inside generated imagery.
imageryNotes: Favor atmospheric gradients, topographic line work, and softly lit architectural or workspace photography.
Keep one quiet region in every campaign image for an editable headline and CTA overlay.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Electric blue fill with warm-white text and a compact 8 px radius.

components.name: Coral signal pill
components.description: Small coral capsule for a category, metric, or campaign label.

templates.name: Feed post — 4:5
templates.description: Atmospheric background, serif headline in the upper third, short proof point, and blue CTA.

templates.name: Story cover — 9:16
templates.description: Full-bleed scene with an open left column for native text and a small coral signal pill.

templates.name: Carousel — 4:5
templates.description: Warm-white content cards connected by blue topographic or orbital line motifs.

assetPrompts.name: Navy orbital field
assetPrompts.intendedUse: Feed post and presentation title background
assetPrompts.prompt: Abstract premium campaign background on a deep navy #0B163F field, thin orbital paths and restrained topographic contours in electric blue #2457FF and mist blue #A9B6D3, subtle depth, precise editorial geometry, soft directional glow from the upper right, high negative space across the left 45 percent for an editable headline, crisp edges, sophisticated technology studio mood, no embedded typography.
assetPrompts.negativePrompt: No words, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signatures, neon rainbow colors, busy central subject, clip-art, or illegible symbols.
assetPrompts.layeringNotes: Place warm-white or coral SVG text in the open left column; keep the logo as a separate vector layer.

assetPrompts.name: Warm editorial horizon
assetPrompts.prompt: Minimal warm-white #F7F4EC editorial background with a low abstract horizon made from one coral #FF735C translucent plane and one electric-blue #2457FF arc, tactile paper-lighting, gentle shadow separation, quiet upper two-thirds for copy, modern art-direction studio aesthetic, controlled asymmetry, high-resolution texture without visible grain clumps.
assetPrompts.negativePrompt: No text, alphabet characters, logos, watermarks, photographs of people, heavy noise, stock-template look, or additional colors.
assetPrompts.layeringNotes: Use navy native text and an electric-blue CTA beneath the headline.

assetPrompts.name: Soft paper and contour grain
assetPrompts.prompt: Seamless subtle material texture combining warm-white #F7F4EC uncoated paper fibers with extremely faint mist-blue #A9B6D3 contour lines, even illumination, low contrast, tileable edges, refined editorial print finish, designed for overlay use.
assetPrompts.negativePrompt: No words, logos, stains, folds, torn edges, high-contrast scratches, objects, frames, or dark vignette.
assetPrompts.layeringNotes: Blend with Multiply or Soft Light and keep editable type above the texture.

assetPrompts.name: Electric glass haze
assetPrompts.intendedUse: Dark-mode hero plate and motion backdrop
assetPrompts.prompt: Deep navy #0B163F atmospheric glass haze with one diffused electric-blue #2457FF light bloom and a very small coral #FF735C reflected edge, cinematic but abstract, premium translucent layers, controlled grain, dark negative space in the center for editable copy, soft parallax-ready depth.
assetPrompts.negativePrompt: No typography, logos, planets, faces, products, lens-flare text, rainbow gradients, watermarks, or dense particles.
assetPrompts.layeringNotes: Crop into motion plates and animate a slow two-percent scale change behind native text.

assetPrompts.name: Precision navigation icons
assetPrompts.prompt: A coherent sheet of twelve minimal vector-style interface icons for strategy, research, collaboration, growth, reporting, launch, security, and support; consistent 2 px rounded stroke, deep navy #0B163F lines, electric-blue #2457FF primary accent, one restrained coral #FF735C signal dot, simple geometric construction, generous spacing, flat transparent-looking background, no text labels.
assetPrompts.negativePrompt: No words, letters, logos, gradients, 3D emoji, photorealism, mixed stroke weights, shadows, watermarks, or brand marks.
assetPrompts.layeringNotes: Treat generated icons as direction; redraw or vectorize approved symbols before production use.

assetPrompts.name: Connected insight map
assetPrompts.prompt: Editorial systems illustration on warm white #F7F4EC: a small network of navy #0B163F nodes connected by electric-blue #2457FF orbital paths, a few coral #FF735C decision markers, precise thin lines, balanced asymmetry, generous blank margin, human-centered strategy and insight metaphor without literal dashboards, clean vector-print aesthetic.
assetPrompts.negativePrompt: No text, labels, logos, stock business people, handshake imagery, pseudo-data numbers, watermarks, or crowded infographic panels.
assetPrompts.layeringNotes: Reserve the top-left margin for an editable title and add verified data labels separately.

assetPrompts.name: Collaborative studio documentary
assetPrompts.intendedUse: Website-derived social proof and culture post
assetPrompts.prompt: Editorial documentary photograph of a small multidisciplinary team collaborating in a modern daylight studio, authentic working moment rather than posing, warm-white architectural surfaces, deep-navy wardrobe accents, one subtle electric-blue object, soft window light, natural skin texture, medium-wide composition, open negative space above and to the left for editable copy, premium magazine color grade.
assetPrompts.negativePrompt: No text, logos, watermarks, staged handshake, everyone staring at camera, exaggerated smiles, distorted hands, unreadable screen text, or generic corporate stock-photo lighting.
assetPrompts.layeringNotes: Use only when the site supports people-led photography; otherwise replace with the observed photography direction.

assetPrompts.name: Signal and trajectory plate
assetPrompts.prompt: Abstract data-trajectory composition on deep navy #0B163F, one clear electric-blue #2457FF rising path, mist-blue #A9B6D3 reference grid, a single coral #FF735C focal marker, spacious premium visualization style, no numeric labels, accurate geometry, quiet lower-right region for an editable proof point and source line.
assetPrompts.negativePrompt: No numbers, letters, fake charts, logos, stock tickers, watermarks, rainbow data series, clutter, or misleading axes.
assetPrompts.layeringNotes: Add verified metrics and source attribution as native text; do not imply a quantitative claim from the background alone.

subheads: We connect research, strategy, and design so your next decision becomes easier to make and easier to explain.
A collaborative process for turning complex ideas into practical tools, campaigns, and experiences.
Build a clear message and a reusable system before production begins.
socialHooks: The asset is rarely the first problem. The missing decision is.
If every channel tells a different story, start with the system.
A good strategy should survive the handoff.
Before you make more content, make the message easier to repeat.

bodyBlocks.name: Campaign introduction
bodyBlocks.text: Bring the research, opinions, and half-formed ideas. We will help shape them into a clear direction and a system your team can carry forward.

bodyBlocks.name: Social proof setup
bodyBlocks.text: The goal is not another presentation that gets filed away. It is a shared way to make the next decision, brief the next asset, and keep the story consistent.

claimsToVerify: Replace the fictional proof point with a sourced fact.

notes: All derived copy is draft language, not text observed on the website.
Keep copy editable when compositing it over generated backgrounds.

consistencyNotes: Reserve coral for a single signal or emphasis per composition.
Do not mix the serif display face into small UI or body copy.
Generated backgrounds should preserve deliberate empty space for native text.
